packages.name: Ask the page
packages.description: Answers questions about this page with a language model, from the plugins it is made of.

packages.name: Board
packages.description: Questions from the app's agents, waiting for your answer, and what they did lately.

packages.name: Clock
packages.description: Provides the clock service: the time now in any time zone.

packages.name: Debug console
packages.description: A bug button that shows errors and the trace, ready to copy into a bug report.

packages.name: Hook tracer
packages.description: Shows each hook an action runs, in order, and what every plugin listening said.

packages.name: Import and export
packages.description: Buttons to save each of the app's collections to a CSV or JSON file, and to import a file's rows into one.

packages.name: Plugin editor
packages.description: Write a plugin, or change a copy of one on the page, and see what it asks for before it runs.

packages.name: Reset
packages.description: Turns every plugin on the page back on.

packages.name: Switchboard
packages.description: A switch for each plugin on the page.

packages.name: Sync
packages.description: In a space: whether this page reaches it, and the versions of records it kept when someone else changed them first.

packages.name: Undo
packages.description: Undo and Redo buttons that take back the app's most recent change to its data, and put it back again.

packages.name: View source
packages.description: Shows the code of every plugin on the page, and what each one may do.

packages.name: World clock
packages.description: The time in London, New York and Tokyo, at the foot of the page.
